Development of tourist attractiveness of the region…

t: Симонян отправится в Москву на встречу секретарей Совбезов СНГ

de: Alen Simonyan will head the Armenian delegation at the 14th meeting of the secretaries of the CIS security councils, which will be held on November 8-9 in Moscow. The corresponding decision on his secondment was signed by Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan.

de: In the village of Jrambar in the Aragatsotn region of Armenia, on the morning of October 30, wolves penetrated into the barn of a local resident and tore 35 lambs, about 30 animals were seriously injured.

de: The Rostov Region State Traffic Inspectorate warned drivers about the deterioration of road conditions due to rain and wind with gusts of up to 14 meters per second, which are expected in the region on October 31.
